purpose: Problem-family assimilation routines for M2D-SBA-06 after concept teaching and before Revised Core (2) transfer.

transfer_routines.title: Projectile coordinate at a wall
recognition_signals: a wall, screen, pole or known horizontal coordinate is given
height, clearance or projectile coordinate at that x-position is asked
the wall coordinate is not itself a time

method_steps.title: Draw the event
method_steps.learner_move: Mark the wall at a fixed horizontal position and keep it distinct from time.

method_steps.title: Find or read the components
method_steps.learner_move: Resolve the launch or read u_x and u_y directly if already supplied.

method_steps.title: Choose a route
method_steps.learner_move: Either find the shared time from x=u_x t and use y(t), or substitute the wall x-coordinate directly into y(x).

method_steps.title: Check the result
method_steps.learner_move: Require a positive event time and a height below the corresponding no-gravity straight-line rise.

independent_practice.prompt: A projectile is launched with u_x=15 m/s and u_y=20 m/s. Take g=10 m/s^2. A wall is 12 m away horizontally. Find the projectile height when it reaches the wall.

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: The wall gives a horizontal position event, not a time.

hint_ladder.label: Representation
hint_ladder.prompt: Use x=u_x t to connect the wall coordinate to the shared clock, then use the vertical equation at that same t.

readiness_checks: recognise a wall as x=constant rather than time
represent the event with the component model
choose t=x/u_x or direct y(x) without H2/H3
finish and physically check a fresh wall-coordinate problem
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q38 after 4/4 readiness without H2/H3.

transfer_routines.title: Trajectory from vector notation
recognition_signals: initial velocity is written using i-hat and j-hat
the trajectory equation or y as a function of x is requested
finding a launch angle is unnecessary

method_steps.title: Read components directly
method_steps.learner_move: From u=a i-hat+b j-hat, take u_x=a and u_y=b.

method_steps.title: Substitute before simplifying
method_steps.learner_move: Keep the component ratio and the squared horizontal denominator visible until values are inserted.

method_steps.title: Audit the result
method_steps.learner_move: Check y(0)=0, a negative x^2 coefficient and consistent dimensions.

independent_practice.prompt: The initial velocity is u=8 i-hat+6 j-hat m/s. Take g=10 m/s^2. Derive the trajectory equation y(x).

hint_ladder.label: Key physics
hint_ladder.prompt: The coefficients of i-hat and j-hat are already the initial horizontal and vertical components.

hint_ladder.label: First move
hint_ladder.prompt: Substitute u_x=8 m/s and u_y=6 m/s before simplifying.

readiness_checks: recognise vector coefficients as velocity components
write the component-form trajectory without first finding theta
substitute u_x and u_y correctly including u_x^2
simplify and audit a fresh trajectory equation
transfer_routines.release_rule: Release Q47 after 4/4 readiness without H2/H3.
